name: coldsearch
description: Unified search CLI - one interface, multiple providers

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then((fs) => fs.rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-reporter=dot test/*.test.mjs test/adapters/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:docs: npm run build && node --test test/capability-matrix-drift.test.mjs && node scripts/validate-docs.mjs

author: Patrick MacLyman
